info.name: CafeMitra Server API
info.description: Import this collection in Postman. Set base_url if your Django server is not running on 127.0.0.1:8000. Source: cafemitra_server/api/urls.py and cafemitra_server/api/views.py.

request.description: GET /api/check/server/status/ | src: api.views.check_server_status

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "Cafe Owner",
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "phone": "{{phone}}",
  "subject": "General query",
  "message": "Need help setting up my print shop."
}

request.description: POST /api/contact-us/ | src: api.views.contact_message
POST /api/tools/ai-upscale-image/ | src: api.views.ai_upscale_image | Returns the upscaled image binary. Requires AI_UPSCALE_API_URL configured on the server.

formdata.description: Optional JSON array of 1-based page numbers to extract

request.description: POST /api/tools/extract-pdf-text/ | src: api.views.extract_pdf_text | Requires PyMuPDF (fitz) installed on the server.
POST /api/tools/remove-image-background/ | src: api.views.remove_image_background
POST /api/tools/website-to-image/ | src: api.views.website_to_image | width: 390 | 768 | 1280 | 1440 | 1920. format: png | jpeg. Requires WEBSITE_SCREENSHOT_API_URL configured on the server.
POST /api/tools/detect-faces/ | src: api.views.detect_faces | Requires opencv-python (cv2) installed on the server.

exec: pm.test('status is 201 or account exists', function () {

request.description: POST /api/auth/register/ | src: api.views.register_user
POST /api/auth/verify-email/ | src: api.views.verify_email | Paste token from console/email into verification_token.
POST /api/auth/resend-verification/ | src: api.views.resend_verification

POST /api/auth/login/ | src: api.views.login_user | Saves token, refresh_token, and shop_code on success. Each login/refresh gets its own AuthToken row, so a browser session and the desktop Print Agent no longer invalidate each other's token.
POST /api/auth/refresh/ | src: api.views.refresh_token
POST /api/auth/request-password-reset/ | src: api.views.request_password_reset
POST /api/auth/reset-password/ | src: api.views.reset_password | Paste token into reset_token.
POST /api/auth/change-password/ | src: api.views.change_password
POST /api/auth/delete-account/ | src: api.views.delete_account_by_email | Also accepts DELETE. Permanently deletes the account and its uploaded documents.
GET /api/profile/ | src: api.views.profile
PUT /api/profile/ | src: api.views.profile
GET /api/wallet/ | src: api.views.wallet
POST /api/wallet/withdraw/ | src: api.views.request_withdrawal
GET /api/pricing-settings/ | src: api.views.pricing_settings
PUT /api/pricing-settings/ | src: api.views.pricing_settings | serviceKey: auto_document_print | passport_photo

GET /api/orders/ | src: api.views.order_history | Latest 100 orders across all services, including passport photo orders with photoStatus/geminiPhoto/passportPrompt fields for the raw/gemini photo compare modal.
GET /api/orders/<order_id>/ | src: api.views.order_detail

POST /api/orders/<order_id>/mark-paid/ | src: api.views.mark_passport_order_paid | Order History 'Mark as Paid' action for cash passport-photo orders (service_key=passport_photo, paymentStatus=No Payment only).
POST /api/orders/<order_id>/approve-cash/ | src: api.views.approve_cash_order
POST /api/orders/<order_id>/reject-cash/ | src: api.views.reject_cash_order
GET /api/orders/<order_id>/file/ | src: api.views.order_document | Owner Order History 'Print' action - downloads the original uploaded document as an attachment.
GET /api/public-shop/<code>/ | src: api.views.public_shop_by_code

formdata.description: Online Payment | Cash Counter | No Payment
Passport photo AI prompt, only used when serviceKey=passport_photo

request.description: POST /api/public-shop/<code>/orders/ | src: api.views.public_print_order | multipart/form-data; set document_path to a real local file.
GET /api/public-orders/<order_id>/ | src: api.views.public_order_status
POST /api/public-orders/<order_id>/mark-paid/ | src: api.views.public_mark_order_paid
POST /api/public-orders/<order_id>/check-upi-payment/ | src: api.views.public_check_upi_payment
POST /api/public-orders/<order_id>/razorpay/order/ | src: api.views.public_create_razorpay_order | Only works when Razorpay is the active payment gateway and the order is awaiting online payment.
POST /api/public-orders/<order_id>/razorpay/verify/ | src: api.views.public_verify_razorpay_payment | Fill in values returned by Razorpay Checkout after payment.
POST /api/public-orders/<order_id>/delete-document/ | src: api.views.public_delete_order_document | Works after order status is printed.

formdata.value: Generate a passport size photo with a plain white background.

request.description: POST /api/save-raw-passport-photo/ | src: api.views.save_raw_passport_photo | Creates a PrintOrder (service_key=passport_photo) for the wizard flow; saves order_id on success.
POST /api/api-passport-photo-check/ | src: api.views.check_passport_photo | Polls (up to 5x, 5s apart) for the Agent-generated final photo on the order created via Save Raw Passport Photo.
GET /api/agent/jobs/ | src: api.views.agent_jobs | Print-queue jobs only (excludes passport_photo service, see Agent Passport Jobs folder).
POST /api/agent/jobs/<order_id>/status/ | src: api.views.agent_job_status | status: printing | printed | failed

POST /api/agent/jobs/<order_id>/status/ | src: api.views.agent_job_status | status: printing | printed | failed. Marking as printed settles the wallet (credits online-paid orders, tracks cash-counter collections).
POST /api/agent/jobs/<order_id>/status/ | src: api.views.agent_job_status | status: printing | printed | failed

POST /api/agent/jobs/<order_id>/gemini-photo/ | src: api.views.agent_upload_gemini_photo | Stores the AI-generated photo on any order (not limited to passport_photo) for the Order History raw/gemini compare modal.
GET /api/agent/passport-jobs/ | src: api.views.agent_passport_jobs | Lists pending passport-photo AI jobs (photoStatus=pending) waiting to be claimed by the desktop Print Agent.
POST /api/agent/passport-jobs/<job_id>/claim/ | src: api.views.claim_passport_job | Atomically moves the job from pending to claimed; 409 if another agent already claimed it.

formdata.description: Leave empty to complete successfully, or set to 'failed' with a 'message' field and omit final_image

request.description: POST /api/agent/passport-jobs/<job_id>/complete/ | src: api.views.complete_passport_job | On success uploads final_image and sets photoStatus=done; on failure send status=failed and message instead.
GET /api/agent/version-check/ | src: api.views.agent_version_check | Anonymous. Returns plain-text version from media/agent/version.txt.
GET /api/agent/update/ | src: api.views.agent_update_download | Anonymous. Downloads media/agent/PrintPilot-latest.zip.

POST /api/google-places/ | src: api.views.google_places | No auth. Single object body. Rejects with 409 if name already exists. Saves place_id on success. Also accepts a JSON array of objects for bulk create (see next request).
POST /api/google-places/ | src: api.views.google_places | No auth. JSON array body - creates each entry, skipping ones whose name already exists (duplicates listed under 'skipped' in the response).
GET /api/google-places/ | src: api.views.google_places | No auth. extracted_status filter defaults to all when omitted.
PUT (or PATCH) /api/google-places/<place_id>/ | src: api.views.google_place_detail | No auth. No body needed - always sets extracted_status=true.
DELETE /api/google-places/<place_id>/ | src: api.views.google_place_detail | No auth.

request.description: POST /api/google-place-details/ | src: api.views.google_place_details | No auth. Single object body. Rejects with 409 if maps_url already exists. Saves place_detail_id on success. Also accepts a JSON array of objects for bulk create (see next request).

request.description: POST /api/google-place-details/ | src: api.views.google_place_details | No auth. JSON array body - creates each entry, skipping ones whose maps_url already exists (duplicates listed under 'skipped' in the response).

query.description: Optional case-insensitive contains filter on name; leave empty to list all

request.description: GET /api/google-place-details/ | src: api.views.google_place_details | No auth.
GET /api/google-place-details/<detail_id>/ | src: api.views.google_place_detail_item | No auth.

PUT/PATCH /api/google-place-details/<detail_id>/ | src: api.views.google_place_detail_item | No auth. Send only the fields to change (any of: name, address, image, latitude, longitude, maps_url, phone, rating, reviews, website).
DELETE /api/google-place-details/<detail_id>/ | src: api.views.google_place_detail_item | No auth.
